headline: Sensex rebounds 990 points to settle above 25,500 driven by strong auto sector rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex surged 990 points to cross 25,500 as Nifty Bank traded near a new high.
Nifty Auto soared 4% during the session, driving market momentum.
Nifty FMCG snapped its two-day losing streak to support the rally.
Markets recovered strongly despite early pressure from Fed rate hike concerns and selling in IT and metal stocks.
whatHappening: Tata Technologies set a target to double its revenue by $1.3 billion by 2030.
PM Modi pulled up India Inc regarding employment, wage growth, Make in India, and FTA planning.
Razorpay is preparing to file for its Indian IPO as early as next week.
Government revised PUC validity norms, giving longer intervals for BS-VI vehicles.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a sharp recovery on 19 November 2026, with the Sensex rebounding 990 points to close above 25,500. The rally was driven by a 4% surge in auto stocks, led by Maruti Suzuki, while Nifty Bank closed near a record high. Meanwhile, Tata Technologies unveiled aggressive long-term revenue targets and Razorpay prepared for an upcoming IPO.
